g.text: A bias invisible case by case, visible in the running total
A bias invisible case by case, visible in the running total
Weekly early-warning flag rate in one sector
dotted: baseline 6%, dashed: control limits 2.8% and 9.2%
Synthetic data: 500 reviews a week, baseline flag rate 6%, 4.8% from week 13. At threshold 4, a false alarm comes about once every 290 weeks.
